content.comment_body: I received a notification about the new platform [version_no]. I got a link in an email to an application sample, which made me very enthusiastic, but unfortunately, nothing was available yet! [url] There was an announcement about integration with AWS cloud. I was disappointed when I found out the sample program couldn't be loaded. It seems we have to wait a bit longer for the new features.
On 10/13/2020, I started a topic on the first application example about connecting [product_name] to a cloud system.
It appears the latest versions of [product_name] software ([version_no]) and [product_name] Web Editor ([version_no]) are needed.

Thanks [user_name]. I've already checked that thread. That's what got me excited originally. However, I still can't find any downloads for [product_name] programming software anywhere. I was hoping I'd just missed a link. I want to start testing and deploying as soon as possible.

There's still no update available for [product_name] software [version_no]. If you order the software on a CD or DVD, it's unclear because the order number has been consistent since [version_no]. The English manual is accessible, though, in [document].

The order numbers for [product_name] [version_no] are now activated on the marketplace. The [product_name] modules can also be ordered, but there isn't a delivery date listed yet. The pricing should remain unchanged. For example: [article_no]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are enthusiastic about the announcement of [product_name] [version_no] and its cloud integration, but they are frustrated with the lack of availability for the required software and sample programs. The inability to access downloads prevents testing and deployment, leading to unmet expectations. There is uncertainty around availability, especially for digital versus physical orders, and product documentation has been released ahead of the actual software, heightening anticipation but also leading to further disappointment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect quick and easy access to newly announced software versions and sample programs so they can immediately begin testing and using new features such as cloud integration.
